content: Ye Sedesiɑsi Yosiɑsin bii, Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko u bɑndu di u kpɑ, n tɛ fiiko, yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ Yeremi ɡɑri kuɑ u nɛɛ,
Yeremi, ɑ tii suɡubɑ kuo kɑ mɑɑ wɛ̃ɛ ɑ ye sɔbe,

kpɑ ɑ ye sɔmɔbu wɛ̃ be sinɑm beni, Edɔmubɑn sunɔ, kɑ Mɔɑbubɑn sunɔ, kɑ Amɔnibɑn sunɔ, kɑ Tirin sunɔ, kɑ Sidonin sunɔ bɑ ɡɔrɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ Sedesiɑsi, Yudɑbɑn sinɑ bokon mi, kpɑ ben bɑɑwure u kɑ ye win yinni dɑɑwɑ.
Kpɑ ɑ mɑɑ bu sɔ̃ bu ben yinnibu sɔ̃ bu nɛɛ, nɛ, Gusunɔ, wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni, wi Isirelibɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑmɔ, nɑ nɛɛ,
nɛnɑ nɑ tem tɑkɑ kuɑ kɑ tɔmbu kɑ yɛɛ yi yi wɑ̃ɑ mɛ sɔɔ, kɑ nɛn dɑm bɑkɑm. Wi nɑ kĩ, wiyɑ nɑ rɑ mu wɛ̃.
Wee tɛ̃ kon bɛɛn tem mɛ kpuro nɛn sɔm kowo Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ, Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko wɛ̃. Kpɑ n de sere kɑ ɡbeeku yɛɛyɔ yi nùn sɔmburu kuɑ.
Bwesenu kpuro nu koo wi kɑ win bibu, kɑ win debuminu sɑ̃. Adɑmɑ sɑɑ ɡɑɑ koo nɑ yè sɔɔ bwese dɑmɡinu ni nu sinɑm dɑmɡibu mɔ, nu koo rɑ win tii kɑ win temɡibu yoru mwɑ.
Bweseru ɡɑru tɑ̀ n yinɑ tu Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ sɑ̃ tu nùn yoru diiyɑ, nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ, kon de u bwese te tɑbu wɔri. Kon mɑɑ tu bɑrɑru kɑ ɡɔ̃ɔru kpɛ̃ɛ, u kɑ kpĩ u tu kpeerɑsiɑ.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, bɛɛ, i ku mɑɑ bɛɛn sɔmɔbu swɑɑ dɑki, kɑ bɛɛn sɔrobu kɑ bɛɛn tiin dosusu, kɑ bɛɛn ɡɔri sokobu, be, be bɑ rɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ bu nɛɛ, i ǹ ko Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko sɑ̃.
Domi weesɑ bɑ ɡerumɔ, ye yɑ koo de n bɛɛ tondɑsiɑ bɛɛn tem di kpɑ n bɛɛ kpeerɑsiɑ.
Adɑmɑ bwese te tɑ wurɑ tu Bɑbilonin sinɑ bokon suɡu sɔbe, tu nùn yoru diiyɑ, kon bwese te deri ten tem sɔɔ kpɑ tu ɡbeɑ ko mi, tɑ n wɑ̃ɑ. Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Mɑ Yeremi u mɑɑ ɡɑri tee yi Sedesiɑsi sɔ̃ɔwɑ. U nɛɛ, Sedesiɑsi, wunɛ kɑ wunɛn tɔmbu, i Bɑbilonin sinɑ bokon suɡu dokeo, i nùn yoru diiyɑ, wi kɑ win tɔmbu, kpɑ i wɑ i n wɑ̃ɑ.

Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ kɑɑ de bu wunɛ kɑ wunɛn tɔmbu ɡo tɑbu sɔɔ, ǹ kun mɛ i ɡbi ɡɔ̃ɔru kɑ bɑrɑnun sɔ̃ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ. U nɛɛ, bwese te tɑ yinɑ tu Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko wiru kpĩiyɑ tɑ koo ɡbiwɑ nɡe mɛ.
U mɑɑ nɛɛ, i ku sɔmɔ ben ɡɑri swɑɑ dɑki, be, be bɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ bɑ mɔ̀, i ǹ Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko yoru diiyɑmmɛ. Domi ɡɑri weesuɡiiyɑ bɑ mɔ̀.
N ǹ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ bu ɡɔrɑ. Bɑ ɡɑri mɔ̀wɑ kɑ nɛn yĩsiru ɑdɑmɑ weesɑ bɑ mɔ̀. Ì n bu swɑɑ dɑki, kon bɛɛ ɡirɑwɑ, kpɑ i ɡbi, bɛɛ kɑ be sɑnnu.

Mɑ Yeremi u mɑɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ tɔn be bɑ mɛnnɛ mi, ɡɑri yi sɔ̃ɔwɑ. U nɛɛ, wee ye Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ. U nɛɛ, i ku bɛɛn sɔmɔbun ɡɑri swɑɑ dɑki, be bɑ ɡerumɔ bɑ mɔ̀, bɑ koo kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun dendi yɑ̃nu wurɑmɑ sɑɑ Bɑbilonin di n ǹ tɛɛmɔ. Domi ɡɑri weesuɡiiyɑ bɑ mɔ̀ mi.
I ku bu swɑɑ dɑki. I Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko wiru kpĩiyɔ, kpɑ i wɑ i n wɑ̃ɑ. Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i ko i de bɛsɛn wuu ɡeni ɡu ko bɑnsu.

Yeremi u mɑɑ nɛɛ, sɔmɔ be, bɑ̀ n sɑ̃ɑn nɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔbu kɑ ɡem mɑ win ɡɑriyɑ bɑ kpɑrɑmɔ, bu nùn kɑnɔ, wi, wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni, u ku de bu yɑ̃ɑ ni ɡurɑ ni nu tie win sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ kɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑ kpɑɑrɔ kɑ Yerusɑlɛmu sɔɔ kpuro, bu kɑ dɑ Bɑbiloniɔ.

Domi sɑnɑm mɛ Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko u Yoyɑkini, Yoyɑkimun bii, Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko yoru mwɑ kɑ win sinɑ ɑsɑkpɔbu, u ǹ ɡinɑ dendi yɑ̃ɑ nini ɡure, ɡberebɑ, kɑ boo sii ɡɑnduɡuu, kɑ ɡen sɔwɑritii, kɑ dendi yɑ̃ɑ ni nu tie Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
Wee ye Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ dendi yɑ̃ɑ nin sɔ̃.
U nɛɛ, ni kpurowɑ bɑ koo ɡurɑ bu kɑ dɑ Bɑbiloniɔ. Miyɑ nu ko n wɑ̃ɑ sere win tii u rɑ kɑ de bu kɑ nu wurɑmɑ min di.
Yeremi
kɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Hɑnɑniɑ
